manifest.request_verbatim:
Design a model rocket plane (boost-glide airframe) with an integrated central flight computer: MCU (STM32F4-class) + 3V3 buck, MPU6050 IMU, BMP280 baro, LIS3MDL mag, NEO-6M GPS. Full multi-domain mission:
1) PLAN the system (airframe + avionics architecture, interfaces, budgets).
2) PART SOURCING — resolve every IC/connector/fastener via the parts library and/or ecad_find_part; record BOM with provenance.
3) SCHEMATIC — ecad_new_schematic / place / WIRE nets (ecad_connect / net tools) so the netlist has simulatable devices before SPICE.
4) SPICE — ecad_simulate OP on the wired 3V3 front-end; measure V(3V3).
5) PCB LAYOUT + TRACE OPT — REQUIRED chain: board_from_schematic → ecad_optimize_traces → ecad_run_drc (errors==0 or honest FAIL).
6) ANTENNA/RF — ecad_antenna_design + analyze for 2.4 GHz IFA and GPS patch; use openEMS path when provisioned, else document honest degrade/SKIP.
7) FIRMWARE — fw_new_project(stm32f4) + pinmap from netlist + fw_build.
8) RENODE SENSOR-IN-THE-LOOP — climb_turn_profile → fw_sensor_scenario → fw_sim_run + fw_verify_board; SKIP honestly if Renode absent.
9) MECHANICAL — model the rocket-plane airframe as editable CAD with verify_battery PASS: body tube ~OD 40–60mm length ≥300mm, 3–4 fins, wing/glide surface, closed payload bay volume ≥ board envelope; use sketch+extrude/revolve + fillets; avoid zero-thickness and open shells.
10) Deliver a consolidated mission report card (PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP per leg) and power_budget rollup.
Use subagent delegation freely (infinitely-branching, spawn-depth policy active) to parallelize mechanical vs ECAD vs firmware vs RF workstreams. Autonomy: auto.

manifest.request_verbatim:
Design a model rocket plane (boost-glide airframe) with an integrated central flight computer: MCU (STM32F4-class) + 3V3 buck, MPU6050 IMU, BMP280 baro, LIS3MDL mag, NEO-6M GPS. Full multi-domain mission:
1) PLAN the system (airframe + avionics architecture, interfaces, budgets).
2) PART SOURCING — resolve every IC/connector/fastener via the parts library and/or ecad_find_part; record BOM with provenance.
3) SCHEMATIC — ecad_new_schematic / place / WIRE nets (ecad_connect / net tools) so the netlist has simulatable devices before SPICE.
4) SPICE — ecad_simulate OP on the wired 3V3 front-end; measure V(3V3).
5) PCB LAYOUT + TRACE OPT — REQUIRED chain: board_from_schematic → ecad_optimize_traces → ecad_run_drc (errors==0 or honest FAIL).
6) ANTENNA/RF — ecad_antenna_design + analyze for 2.4 GHz IFA and GPS patch; use openEMS path when provisioned, else document honest degrade/SKIP.
7) FIRMWARE — fw_new_project(stm32f4) + pinmap from netlist + fw_build.
8) RENODE SENSOR-IN-THE-LOOP — climb_turn_profile → fw_sensor_scenario → fw_sim_run + fw_verify_board; SKIP honestly if Renode absent.
9) MECHANICAL — model the rocket-plane airframe as editable CAD with verify_battery PASS: body tube ~OD 40–60mm length ≥300mm, 3–4 fins, wing/glide surface, closed payload bay volume ≥ board envelope; use sketch+extrude/revolve + fillets; avoid zero-thickness and open shells.
10) Deliver a consolidated mission report card (PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP per leg) and power_budget rollup.
Use subagent delegation freely (infinitely-branching, spawn-depth policy active) to parallelize mechanical vs ECAD vs firmware vs RF workstreams. Autonomy: auto.
